tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search for text in messages across all past conversations. Returns matches grouped by channel with context snippets.

query.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive, minimum 2 characters)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100)

tools.name: list-channels
tools.description: List past conversations. Returns channel names, agents, and last message preview.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get-channel-messages
tools.description: Get messages from a specific past conversation. Supports pagination.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to get messages from

before.description: Message ID for pagination - get messages before this one

textOnly.description: Only return text messages, excluding tool executions (default: true)

tools.name: get-channel-summary
tools.description: Get a quick summary of a conversation without all messages. Useful to understand what a conversation was about.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to summarize

tools.name: create-conversation
tools.description: Create a new conversation with a specific agent. Returns the new channel ID that can be used to send messages.

agentId.description: The ID of the agent to start a conversation with

tools.name: delegate-task
tools.description: Delegate a task to a new sub-conversation with an agent (defaults to yourself). Creates the conversation, sends the task prompt, and returns immediately. The sub-agent works independently and each of its responses is automatically forwarded back to this conversation.

prompt.description: Full task description and instructions to send to the sub-agent

agentId.description: Agent ID to delegate to. Defaults to the current agent (self-delegation).

taskName.description: Optional name for the delegated task conversation

tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Send a message to an existing conversation. The agent will process and respond to the message.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to send the message to

tools.name: rename-channel
tools.description: Rename a conversation. Changes the title/name of a channel. Without channelId it renames the current conversation. Conversations linked to a board task cannot be renamed — rename the task instead and the conversation follows.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to rename. Optional — defaults to the current conversation.

name.description: The new name/title for the conversation

tools.name: import-attachment
tools.description: Copy a file the user uploaded in chat (image or document) into the agent workspace volume so filesystem tools can read it. Identify it by the filename shown in the "[User sent ...]" message reference. Returns { workspacePath, size, mime }.

filename.description: Filename of the chat attachment to import, as shown in the message reference

destPath.description: Optional destination path inside the workspace (relative). Defaults to the original filename at the workspace root.

channelId.description: Channel to import from. Defaults to the current conversation.

messageId.description: Optional message ID to disambiguate when several attachments share a filename.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the destination if it already exists (default: false).

tools.name: redact-by-value
tools.description: Redact every message in a conversation that contains a given secret value — the message where it was pasted, tool outputs like SSH/terminal logs that captured it, your own echoes, and even the arguments of this very call. Use it when a secret leaked into the conversation and you want no trace of it left in plaintext. The owner can still un-redact any message. Returns a coverage report (message ids + count) so you can verify nothing was missed. NEVER use this to hide non-secret content — it is a safety primitive for credentials.

value.description: The exact secret text to sweep for (minimum 4 characters). Every message containing it will be redacted.

channelId.description: The conversation to sweep (default: the current one). Only channels you have access to.

window.description: How many recent messages to scan (default 200, max 1000).

alsoRedact.description: Extra message ids to redact when the exact match misses them (split key, transformed value).
